name: @jps/api-client
description: Typed client for the journal platform API, generated from the backend's OpenAPI schema.

scripts.generate: cd ../../backend && uv run python -m app.cli openapi --output ../packages/api-client/openapi.json && cd ../packages/api-client && openapi-typescript openapi.json --output src/schema.ts --root-types --root-types-no-schema-prefix --enum-values && biome format --write src/schema.ts
